xna-type.name: TouchCollection
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for accessing state information for the touch screen of a touch-enabled device.
xna-type.syntax: public struct TouchCollection : IList<TouchLocation>, ICollection<TouchLocation>, IEnumerable<TouchLocation>, IEnumerable

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the TouchCollection structure with a set of touch locations.

property.name: Count
property.summary: Gets the current number of touch locations for the touch screen.
property.value: Number of current locations. Eight is the maximum number of trackable locations.

property.name: IsConnected
property.summary: Indicates if the touch screen is available for use.
property.value: The value is true if the touch screen is available; otherwise it is false.

property.name: IsReadOnly
property.summary: Determines if the touch location array is read-only.
property.value: The value is true if the array is read-only; otherwise it is false.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Gets or sets the information of the specified touch location.

method.name: Add
method.summary: Adds a TouchLocation to the collection.

overload.summary: Adds a TouchLocation to the collection.

method.name: Clear
method.summary: Removes all TouchLocation objects from the collection.

overload.summary: Removes all TouchLocation objects from the collection.

method.name: Contains
method.summary: Checks if the current touch collection contains the specified touch location.

overload.summary: Checks if the current touch collection contains the specified touch location.

parameters.parameter: Touch location to be checked against the current collection.

overload.returns: The value is true if the item is present in the collection; otherwise it is false.

method.name: CopyTo
method.summary: Copies the touch location to the collection at the specified index.

overload.summary: Copies the touch location to the collection at the specified index.

parameters.parameter: Array receiving the copied touch location.

method.name: FindById
method.summary: Retrieves the touch location matching the specified ID.

overload.summary: Retrieves the touch location matching the specified ID.

parameters.parameter: [ OutAttribute ] Touch location item matching the specified ID.

overload.returns: The return value is true if the item was found; otherwise it is false.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Returns an enumerator that iterates through the TouchCollection.

overload.summary: Returns an enumerator that iterates through the TouchCollection.
overload.returns: An TouchCollection.Enumerator for the touch collection.

method.name: IndexOf
method.summary: Determines the index of a TouchLocation in the TouchCollection.

overload.summary: Determines the index of a TouchLocation in the TouchCollection.

parameters.parameter: TouchLocation to locate in the collection.

overload.returns: The index of the specified touch location; -1 if the touch location could not be found.

method.name: Insert
method.summary: Inserts a new TouchLocation into the TouchCollection at a specified index.

overload.summary: Inserts a new TouchLocation into the TouchCollection at a specified index.

parameters.parameter: Index in the touch collection for the new item.

method.name: Remove
method.summary: Removes the specified TouchLocation from the TouchCollection.

overload.summary: Removes the specified TouchLocation from the TouchCollection.
overload.returns: The return value is true if the item was successfully removed; otherwise it is false.

method.name: RemoveAt
method.summary: Removes a TouchLocation at the specified index in the TouchCollection.

overload.summary: Removes a TouchLocation at the specified index in the TouchCollection.

parameters.parameter: Index of the TouchLocation to remove.
